findings.title: Backup codes can be redeemed more than once concurrently
findings.body: The code is read and validated from a snapshot, then the whole updated array is written without a conditional check or transaction. Two concurrent login requests using the same backup code can both validate against the original array and both receive authenticated sessions, violating the one-time-use guarantee. Consume the code atomically so only one request can succeed.

findings.title: Dismissing the backup-code screen leaves 2FA enabled without notifying the parent
findings.body: After the server enables 2FA, this step only changes the modal's local state; `onEnable()` is called only by the explicit Close button. The dialog can still be dismissed through its `onOpenChange` handler (for example with Escape), which neither notifies the parent nor preserves access to the displayed codes. The settings UI can remain stale, and the user can permanently lose the only display of their backup codes. Handle dismissal at this step by notifying the parent and ensuring the codes are not silently lost.
